13 is a show that knows exactly what it wants to be and exactly how to be it, even if what it wants to be isn't necessarily groundbreaking or sophisticated.

The result is that 13 -- which has book by Dan Elish and Robert Horn, music and lyrics by Jason Robert Brown -- is a show that tries to be all things to all people and ends up being not quite enough for anyone.
I suspect that 'A Free Man of Color' was a lot more fun to write than it is to watch.
The problem with '13' isn't that it's a musical about teenagers performed by teenagers. It's that it's a bad musical about teenagers performed by teenagers.
